title: [finding] Two GraphQL residue sites in package SOURCE comments outlive the removed /graphql route (spec object.zod.ts, adapters/hono index.ts)
body:
Found while fixing #10846 (the five GraphQL residue sites in `skills/**`). Filed rather
than fixed: #10846's PR is a GOVERNED `skills/**` PR, and these two live in package
source — a different surface and a different gate family, so folding them in would be
unreviewable scope creep on a human-merge-only diff.

Same defect class as #10846 / #10710 / #10832 / #10583 / #10835, one surface further in:
prose that still asserts a `/graphql` surface the runtime does not mount.

## The residue

| Site | Text | Why it is wrong |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:252` | `/** Enable REST/GraphQL API access */` (the doc comment on `apiEnabled`) | There is no automatic GraphQL API. `apiEnabled` gates REST and MCP — `packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts:260` reads `enable.apiEnabled === false`. Note the `.describe()` one line below is already correct ("Expose object via automatic APIs"), so only the JSDoc drifted. |
| `packages/adapters/hono/src/index.ts:105-106` | `Only routes that need framework-specific handling (auth service, GraphQL raw result, discovery wrapper) are registered explicitly.` | `createHonoApp` registers auth (`app.all(prefix + '/auth/*')`) and discovery (`app.get(prefix)`, `/discovery`, `/.well-known/objectstack`), then one catch-all. No GraphQL route is registered — and this same file already carries the correct account of its own shape at line 423 (`// --- Storage: deliberately NOT mounted (#4087) ---`). |

## Why it is worth recording

The second one is load-bearing beyond tidiness: the stale `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`
line #10846 fixes ("Mount explicit routes for auth, GraphQL, storage, discovery") reads like a
transcription of exactly this JSDoc, storage included. The published catalog is being corrected
in #10846; leaving the source comment it was copied from intact leaves the regeneration path
open.

Verification at filing time (worktree at `origin/main` afe1c4e0a):

- 0 hits for `createGraphQLDomain` under `packages/*/src`
- `handleGraphQL` survives only in CHANGELOGs (27 hits, all historical)
- `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts:2069` — `// /graphql removed — GraphQL is not in the product plan (#2462 follow-on).`
- `packages/spec/src/system/core-services.zod.ts:130-132` independently records that `graphql` was never a `CoreServiceName` and named "a `/graphql` surface the dispatcher had already removed"

Dedupe: `search_issues` on two phrasings ("GraphQL residue in package source comments object.zod
apiEnabled REST/GraphQL hono adapter JSDoc stale", "createHonoApp doc comment GraphQL raw result
stale storage mount removed adapters hono") returned only CLOSED cards — #10835, #10710, #10832,
#10583, #7707, #9436, #4117. None covers either site.
